description: Source code for generating and managing agent configurations and project setup in a Playwright-based environment, including classes for Claude, Opencode, Copilot, and VSCode generators, along with utility functions for file operations and project initialization.

classes.name: ClaudeGenerator
classes.description: Handles initialization and configuration of Claude agent specifications and MCP server setup.

classes.name: OpencodeGenerator
classes.description: Manages Opencode agent configuration and MCP server setup.

classes.name: CopilotGenerator
classes.description: Handles initialization and configuration of Copilot agents and related MCP setup.

classes.name: VSCodeGenerator
classes.description: Manages VSCode environment setup, including chat modes and MCP JSON configuration.

methods.name: writeFile
methods.description: Utility to write content to a file with logging.

methods.name: deleteFile
methods.description: Utility to delete a file with logging.

methods.name: initRepo
methods.description: Initializes project repository structure, seed files, and prompts.

methods.name: loadPrompt
methods.description: Loads and processes prompt template files with parameters.
